hints.title: Character Equivalence Grouping
hints.text: Whenever lcp[i][j] is greater than 0, the characters at index i and index j must be identical.

hints.title: Greedy Alphabet Assignment
hints.text: Scan from index 0 to n - 1. Assign the smallest available English letter to any unset position and copy that letter to all indices j where lcp[i][j] > 0.

hints.title: Verification Step
hints.text: After constructing the candidate string, compute its longest common prefix matrix using dynamic programming and verify exact match with input.

hints.title: Greedy Construction and Verification Implementation

variables: n: dimension of the lcp matrix
complexity.notes: Greedy assignment takes O(n^2); DP matrix verification takes O(n^2).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying letter combinations without verifying the full longest common prefix grid misses subtle inconsistencies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) auxiliary DP matrix for consistency verification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Constructs string greedily and verifies the full table matches.
